prayerExcerpt.en-US: Rejoice in the Lord always; again I say, rejoice. Indeed, the Lord is near.
prayerExcerpt.pt-BR: Alegrai-vos sempre no Senhor! Repito, alegrai-vos! O Senhor está próximo.

meta.basis: GIRM 346f allows rose 'where it is the practice' on Gaudete Sunday (the repo's formulary gives the day's colour as violet, the obligatory one); the wreath's rose candle is lit this Sunday by custom. Flowers stay moderate, arranged around the altar (GIRM 305).

sources.title: GIRM ch. 6, no. 346 (colours: violet in Advent and Lent, rose on Gaudete and Laetare, white at Christmas, green in Ordinary Time)
GIRM ch. 5, nos. 299, 305, 313 (altar, flowers, organ in Advent and Lent)
Directory on Popular Piety and the Liturgy (2001), nos. 98 (Advent wreath), 104 (crib)
